description: Aditya Sinha and colleagues at North Carolina State University and Carnegie Mellon University publish databases used to analyse alternative US energy-system decarbonisation pathways. The source identifies the study as Diverse Decarbonization Pathways Under Near Cost-Optimal Futures and places the modelling within the Open Energy Outlook. Zenodo lists 181 database files, each retained as a component of this single scenario collection. The short description links the Temoa modelling logic but does not state the represented years, temporal resolution, technology coverage, spatial aggregation or database schema. Those details remain unknown. The files are freely accessible under CC BY 4.0 through the Zenodo landing page. These are model-generated alternatives for energy-system optimisation, not observed energy statistics. The related Temoa catalogue record describes the modelling tool. No database was opened, and reproducing the alternatives or checking their numerical consistency is outside this metadata review.
